finding.claim: Path traversal in /dl: the user-supplied `f` parameter is joined to the root and read with no containment check, so `../` sequences escape /srv/files and allow reading arbitrary files.
finding.sink: os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, name)) at files.go:13, with the contents written to the response at files.go:18

trace.note: filepath.Join cleans '..' lexically, so '../../etc/passwd' resolves to /etc/passwd, outside root
file contents returned to the attacker

finding.guards_checked: No prefix check against root, no filepath.Base, no rejection of '..' or absolute segments, no authentication. Symlinks are not resolved either. Contrast /avatar at line 22, which uses filepath.Base and is safe.

verdict.reason: files.go:12-13 passes the query param `f` straight into filepath.Join(root, name) with no containment check or auth (handler registered at files.go:32), so `../../etc/passwd` resolves outside /srv/files and is written out at files.go:18.
